phases.name: Regression Audit
phases.purpose: Revalidate the shared V3 foundation and classify all recovered review requirements and newly discovered defects.
phases.exit_gate: Every finding has authority classification, owner, correction decision and acceptance evidence; current integration is green or every failure is classified.

phases.name: Core Corrections
phases.purpose: Correct shared runtime, template, normative mapping, documentation and tests identified by the regression.
phases.exit_gate: No unresolved shared FAIL and no NORMATIVE-REVIEW silently encoded as runtime behavior.

phases.name: Reference PDF Validation
phases.purpose: Validate the canonical V3 PDF page by page against accepted UFC requirements, recovered reviews and the V2.1 preservation baseline where applicable.
phases.exit_gate: Visual checklist and reproducible presentation evidence pass.

phases.name: Scientific Article
phases.purpose: Implement the article profile on the corrected shared foundation using the retained authority contract.
phases.exit_gate: Article runtime, modality, positive/negative evidence and canonical rendering pass.

phases.name: Final Certification
phases.purpose: Run the complete profile, engine, literal-font, Unicode, embedding, PDF-A and distribution matrix on one immutable candidate.
phases.exit_gate: Complete certification matrix is green on the same candidate SHA.

phases.name: Release
phases.purpose: Finalize documentation, bundles, release assets, checksums and publication actions.
phases.exit_gate: Release checklist complete with no unresolved roadmap or normative item.

known_shared_priorities: stale V2 wording and retired profile vocabulary in the V3 reference document
